$teacherUid..validate: newData.hasChildren(['teacherUid','teacherName','className','present','total','checkedAt']) && newData.child('teacherUid').val() == $teacherUid && newData.child('present').isNumber() && newData.child('total').isNumber() && newData.child('present').val() >= 0 && newData.child('present').val() <= newData.child('total').val()

$messageId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['senderUid','senderName','text','createdAt']) && newData.child('senderUid').val() == auth.uid && newData.child('senderName').isString() && newData.child('text').isString() && newData.child('text').val().length > 0 && newData.child('text').val().length <= 2000 && newData.child('createdAt').isNumber() && newData.child('createdAt').val() <= now + 10000 && newData.child('senderName').val() == root.child('users').child(auth.uid).child('name').val()

$teacherUid..validate: newData.hasChildren(['enabled','content','repeat','date','start','end','updatedAt']) && newData.child('enabled').isBoolean() && newData.child('content').isString() && newData.child('content').val().length > 0 && newData.child('content').val().length <= 500 && (newData.child('repeat').val() == 'daily' || newData.child('repeat').val() == 'weekdays' || newData.child('repeat').val() == 'once') && newData.child('start').isString() && newData.child('start').val().matches(/^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$/) && newData.child('end').isString() && newData.child('end').val().matches(/^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$/) && newData.child('end').val() > newData.child('start').val() && newData.child('date').isString() && (newData.child('repeat').val() != 'once' || newData.child('date').val().matches(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$/)) && newData.child('updatedAt').isNumber() && newData.child('updatedBy').val() == auth.uid
